title: Concept: Requirement ranged with an open-ended `>=`
description: requirements.txt declares a `>=` specifier with no upper bound, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>=` specifier with no upper bound.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through requirements.txt (pypi).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `>=` specifier with no upper bound.
